items.title: Citrix NetScaler CVE-2026-88771: Observed Exploitation Artifacts and Hunt Indicators
items.content: CVE-2026-88771 is a critical pre-authentication command-injection vulnerability affecting Citrix NetScaler ADC and NetScaler Gateway. LevelBlue's Threat Hunt Operations & Research (THOR) team identified active exploitation across multiple customer environments featuring malicious authentication events with attacker-controlled usernames containing pitboss and NSPPE strings. Observed activities... This pulse includes 5 indicators of compromise (IOCs). Associated malware: main.py, update_c08937.pl.

items.title: PaperCut MF Zero-Day Intrusion: Java Loader, Web Shell, and AdaptixC2 via CVE-2026-82078 and CVE-2026-81578
items.content: On August 31, 2026, threat actors exploited two zero-day vulnerabilities in PaperCut MF affecting a customer in the Education sector. The attackers targeted an internet-facing print server running vulnerable PaperCut MF version 24.0.2, deploying an in-memory Java loader that established a web shell. Associated malware: AdaptixC2.
